title: On Portenko's approximation of skew Brownian motion
summary: From the perspective of the theory of operator semigroups, we reflect back on the classical theorem of Portenko devoted to approximation of skew Brownian motion. The theorem says that by concentrating the power of drift of a diffusion process around a point one obtains an equivalent of a semi-permeable membrane at this point, described by skew Brownian motion's boundary condition. We prove convergence of the corresponding Feller semigroups and in doing so, generalize Portenko's theorem to the case of the Walsh processes on star graphs.
